description: Start, stop or reboot an Impreza Cloud VPS. These are the cloud-VPS machines (a different product from the Proxmox VPS that `impreza_vps_power` drives) — find the vm_id with `impreza_list_services` (use the WHMCS service ID). Only boot, graceful shutdown and reboot are supported. Interrupts a running machine, so confirm with the customer first.
name: impreza_cloud_power
